items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: Kay Mountain. Very good musician. I really like him.

ctx.x: Well it's the same thing in England. The original Superior Paragon. That's crazy. Yeah, that's P. Minter's band.

Oh, he has that. Yeah. I even got the card for it. Does he play very well, B? I only heard him once. He was over here when I was there, see. He came back just before I left. Oh, I see. But he plays kind of, like he's not sure what he's doing or something like that to me. His brother though is a very good musician. His brother is the best drummer in London. Kay? Yeah. Kay Mountain. Very good musician. I really like him. He's better than Barry Martin? Oh yeah. A lot better than Martin. Maybe Martin could play that…
That's a dance band. Oh, that's a jazz band. Yeah, well a jazz dance band, not a brass band.
